packages.name: FlightData
packages.description: Core flight, flight plan, and turn-round data managed throughout the CDM process.

packages.name: CDMProcess
packages.description: The Airport CDM Platform, its milestone process, and consistency-check logic.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The actors involved in the CDM process: Aircraft Operator, Ground Handler, ATC, Network Operations, IFPS.

packages.name: Messaging
packages.description: Messages exchanged between the Airport CDM Platform and Network Operations (DPI, FUM).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single flight (arrival or departure leg) tracked through the CDM milestone process with all its estimated and actual times.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Registration of the aircraft operating the flight, provided by the AO before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and thus receives a CTOT from Network Operations at EOBT-2h.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flight, updated at each milestone.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time from the ATC Flight Plan/airport slot.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target Off-Block Time provided/updated by the AO/GH, used to compute TTOT.

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC.

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations for regulated flights at EOBT-2h.

attributes.name: etot
attributes.description: Estimated Take-Off Time.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target Take-Off Time, calculated from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT.

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by ATC based on traffic load, gate/stand, runway, holding.

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-In Time used to compute EIBT.

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: Estimated Landing Time, updated via FUM, ATOT+elapsed time, or radar detections.

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: Estimated In-Block Time computed from ELDT and EXIT.

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: Actual Landing Time, +/-1 minute accuracy, from ATC system or ACARS.

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: Actual In-Block Time, +/-1 minute accuracy.

attributes.name: acgt
attributes.description: Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, for first-of-day or long-parked flights.

attributes.name: asbt
attributes.description: Actual Start Boarding Time.

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time, when the aircraft is ready for start-up/push-back.

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Request Time.

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Approval Time.

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual Off-Block Time, +/-1 minute accuracy.

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual Take-Off Time, +/-1 minute accuracy.

classes.name: FlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS, which the CDM platform checks for consistency against the airport slot and flight data.

attributes.name: planId
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated off-block time in the flight plan, normally submitted 3 hours before EOBT.

attributes.name: firstDestination
attributes.description: First destination data fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: Estimated elapsed time used with ATOT to calculate ELDT.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether this is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated to the flight, against which the ATC Flight Plan must be consistent, from the airport slot programme.

attributes.name: slotId
attributes.description: Identifier of the airport slot.

attributes.name: scheduledTime
attributes.description: Scheduled time associated with the slot per the airport slot programme.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The turn-round linking an arriving flight and its related departing flight at a coordinated or non-coordinated airport.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum Turn-Round Time used to calculate TOBT/TTOT for the departing flight.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the 16 defined CDM milestone events in a flight's life-cycle, each with a definition, timing, trigger, and resulting operational status change.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: The milestone number (1 to 16).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the milestone, e.g. 'Landed', 'Off-Block'.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time at which the milestone occurred.

attributes.name: triggeredBy
attributes.description: The event/trigger that raises this milestone, e.g. ALDT detection, radar detection.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight transitions to upon this milestone.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The central platform that is initiated for each flight, processes available information, performs consistency checks, records milestones, and triggers messaging to Network Operations.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Verifies consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent (M1).

operations.name: updateELDT
operations.description: Updates ELDT based on FUM messages, ATOT plus elapsed time, or radar detection at FIR/Final Approach/Landing (M2-6).

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT as EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, or EOBT+EXOT if later, or TOBT+EXOT if TOBT is manually input (M2,3).

operations.name: recordMilestone
operations.description: Records the occurrence of a milestone against a flight and updates its operational status.

operations.name: triggerDPI
operations.description: Sends the appropriate DPI message to Network Operations when TTOT changes beyond the agreed tolerance.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT issue exceeds a locally defined threshold (M10).

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline responsible for submitting the ATC Flight Plan and providing TOBT, ready and boarding information for its flights.

attributes.name: operatorId
attributes.description: Identifier of the Aircraft Operator.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling agent that manages the turn-round process and provides estimates such as TOBT, ARDT, ASBT, and ACGT.

attributes.name: handlerId
attributes.description: Identifier of the Ground Handler.

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: An air traffic control unit (Area Control Centre, Approach Control, Tower) that receives the flight plan, detects the flight by radar, and issues TSAT/start-up approval.

attributes.name: unitId
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATC unit.

attributes.name: unitType
attributes.description: Type of ATC unit, e.g. ACC, Approach, Tower.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT for regulated flights, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and receives DPI/FUM messages.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: Issues a Calculated Take-Off Time to a regulated flight at EOBT-2h.

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI) sent from the Airport CDM Platform to Network Operations with updated flight time estimates.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: The specific type of DPI message sent.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the DPI message was sent.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: A Flight Update Message (FUM) sent by Network Operations providing progress updates for an inbound flight within 3 hours flying time of destination.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the FUM was sent.

unmodelled: M1: For long distance flights the ELDT may differ from the airport slot, a nuance of data quality not captured as a distinct rule owner.

M4: The objective to decrease stand/gate changes in the last 30 minutes and the rule that stand/gate changes are not preferred after ELDT-30' is not modelled as a distinct class attribute or operation.
M9-M14: The distinction between voice, DCL (Data Communication / CPDLC), and manual input channels for start-up request/approval is not represented.
M10: The local procedure applied when TOBT update count exceeds a threshold is referenced but its concrete actions are not specified in the document and so not modelled.
M11: The distinction between physical boarding start and passenger pre-call via FIDS/PA systems is not modelled as separate classes.
M15: The special handling of AOBT/A-DPI in case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT is not separately modelled.
M16: FSA and MVT messages sent at Take Off are mentioned but not modelled as distinct message classes.
General: Attachment 2 (DPI process implementation details) and section 3.7.3 are referenced but their content is outside the document's text and not modelled.
